_comment: Single source of truth for site identity and SEO. Set siteUrl to your final production origin (e.g. https://example.com) WITHOUT a trailing slash once the domain is confirmed. While siteUrl is empty, canonical tags, og:url and the sitemap are intentionally NOT emitted, so no placeholder domain can leak into production. Changing name/tagline/description here updates the whole site including meta tags.
